info.title: In•Process API
info.description: The In•Process API enables browsing and managing moments from timelines. Retrieve moments from a specific artist's timeline, browse the in•process collective timeline, or filter by collection. The API supports creating moments, managing collections, handling payments, and interacting with the In•Process protocol ecosystem.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a Moment on the In•Process protocol, including onchain moment data, sales configuration, metadata, and moment admins.

parameters.name: collectionAddress
parameters.description: The contract address of the Moment

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: The token ID of the Moment

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID of the collection (default: Base, 8453)

patch.description:
Update the URI (metadata) of an existing Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows artists to update the metadata URI associated with their Moments.

Optionally provide `newCollectionAddress` to move the moment to a different In•Process 1155 contract. The new collection address must differ from the current moment collection address and must be a valid In•Process 1155 contract.

**Note:** Only Moment admins can update the URI.

post.description:
Create a new Moment on the In•Process protocol. No signature is required for this endpoint.

The API uses a unified `contract` object that supports both creating moments on existing collections and creating new collections:
- **Use existing collection**: Provide `contract.address` to add a moment to a collection you've already created
- **Create new collection**: Provide `contract.name` and `contract.uri` to create both a new collection and its first moment in a single request

Optional: `chainId` (defaults to Base mainnet in production, Base Sepolia in preview or development).

> **Simulate first:** Use [POST /moment/create/simulate](/api-reference/moment/simulate) to validate inputs and estimate gas before submitting a real transaction.

Create multiple moments in a single onchain transaction. Uses the same unified `contract` object as [POST /moment/create](/api-reference/moment/create): provide `contract.address` for an existing collection, or `contract.name` and `contract.uri` to deploy a new collection and mint all batch tokens on it.

Each token can use its own `salesConfig`, `mintToCreatorCount`, `maxSupply`, and `payoutRecipient`. If `splits` are provided, the payout recipient is resolved to the split contract address for all tokens.

Simulate a moment creation without submitting an onchain transaction. Useful for validating inputs and estimating gas before committing.

This endpoint performs two validation steps:
1. **Contract simulation** — validates contract-level logic (no gas spent)
2. **UserOperation preparation** — validates at AA/paymaster level (no broadcast)

Uses the same request body schema as `POST /moment/create`.

> **Ready to create?** Use [POST /moment/create](/api-reference/moment/create) to broadcast the real transaction.

Create a new Writing Moment on the In•Process protocol. No signature is required for this endpoint.

The API uses a unified `contract` object that supports both creating writing moments on existing collections and creating new collections:
- **Use existing collection**: Provide `contract.address` to add a writing moment to a collection you've already created
- **Create new collection**: Provide `contract.name` and `contract.uri` to create both a new collection and its first writing moment in a single request

Optional: `chainId` (defaults to Base mainnet in production, Base Sepolia in preview or development).
Collect a Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows users to collect moments with an optional comment.

get.description:
Retrieve collectors from the In•Process protocol. Returns a ranked list of collectors with their total collected count and spending. Supports filtering by artist and time period.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time period to aggregate stats over. Defaults to `all`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to `20`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-indexed). Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter stats to collectors of moments created by this artist address.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Field to sort results by. Defaults to `collected_count`.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `desc`.

post.description: Airdrop a Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows artists to distribute moments to multiple recipients.

Add admin permissions to a Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows artists to grant admin permissions to other addresses for managing their Moments.

**Note:** Only the current Moment admin can add permissions to other addresses. The transaction is executed via a smart account using Coinbase CDP.

delete.description:
Remove admin permissions from a Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows artists to revoke admin permissions from addresses that were previously granted admin access to their Moments.

**Note:** Only the current Moment admin can remove permissions from other addresses. The transaction is executed via a smart account using Coinbase CDP.

get.description: Retrieve Moment comments on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint returns comments associated with a specific moment.

parameters.name: collectionAddress
parameters.description: Moment contract address

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Token ID

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID (optional, default: Base, 8453)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset (optional, defaults to 0)

post.description:
Update the sale configuration for a Moment on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint allows artists to update the price, sale window, token limit per address, and funds recipient for a Moment's sale.

**Note:** At least one sale field must be provided. Requires authentication via API key.

get.description:
Browse collections from the In•Process protocol. This endpoint can retrieve collections from a specific artist or browse the in•process collective collections, depending on whether the `artist` parameter is provided. Supports pagination for efficient browsing.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

Endpoint behavior:
- When `artist` is provided: Returns collections from the specific artist (only collections created by that artist address).
- When `artist` is omitted: Returns collections from the in•process collective collections.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by artist address (collections created by this artist). When provided, returns the artist's collections. When omitted, returns the in•process collective collections.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max: 100)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID. When omitted, returns moments from all production chains (Ethereum mainnet: 1, Base: 8453).

post.description: Create a new Collection on In•Process.

get.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a Collection on the In•Process protocol, including collection metadata, creator, admins, and timestamps.

Uses [CAIP-2](https://chainagnostic.org/CAIPs/caip-2) for the `network` segment and a CAIP-style asset reference for the `contract` segment:
- `network`: `eip155:{chainId}` (e.g. `eip155:8453` for Base)
- `contract`: `erc1155:{address}` (e.g. `erc1155:0xabc...`)

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: CAIP-2 chain reference in the format `eip155:{chainId}` (e.g. `eip155:8453` for Base mainnet)

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: CAIP-style asset reference in the format `erc1155:{address}` (e.g. `erc1155:0xabc...`)

400.description: Bad request — invalid CAIP format, unsupported namespace, or invalid address

patch.description:
Update the metadata (name and URI) of an existing Collection on the In•Process protocol.

Uses [CAIP-2](https://chainagnostic.org/CAIPs/caip-2) for the `network` segment and a CAIP-style asset reference for the `contract` segment:
- `network`: `eip155:{chainId}` (e.g. `eip155:8453` for Base)
- `contract`: `erc1155:{address}` (e.g. `erc1155:0xabc...`)

**Note:** Only Collection admins can update the metadata.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: CAIP-2 chain reference in the format `eip155:{chainId}` (e.g. `eip155:8453` for Base mainnet)

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: CAIP-style asset reference in the format `erc1155:{address}` (e.g. `erc1155:0xabc...`)

400.description: Bad request — invalid CAIP format, unsupported namespace, invalid address, or missing body fields

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

get.description:
Browse moments from timelines. This endpoint can retrieve moments from a specific artist's timeline or browse the in•process collective timeline, depending on whether the `artist` parameter is provided. Supports pagination for efficient browsing.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

Endpoint behavior:
- When `collection` is provided: Returns all moments (tokens) of the specified collection address.
- When `artist` is provided: Returns moments from the specific artist's timeline (only moments administered by that artist address). The `type` parameter can be used to filter by admin relationship.
- When both `artist` and `collection` are omitted: Returns moments from the in•process collective timeline (moments that are being created, indexed).

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by admin address (only moments administered by this artist address). When provided, returns the artist timeline. When omitted, returns the in•process collective timeline.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Filter by collection address. When provided, returns all moments of the specified collection.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max: 100)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID. When omitted, returns moments from all production chains (Ethereum mainnet: 1, Base: 8453).

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: If true, includes moments marked as hidden by the admin (default: false)

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Filter by MIME type category (e.g. `audio`, `video`, `image`). Used to construct a MIME pattern filter.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Filter moments by time period.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Filter moments by the channel they were created through.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only applicable when `artist` is provided. Determines whether to show moments where the artist is the creator (`default`), moments co-administered with others (`mutual`), or both when not provided.

parameters.name: curated
parameters.description: If true, returns only curated moments (default: false).

get.description:
Retrieve moment transfer records from the In•Process protocol. Use the `type` parameter to filter by transfer category, or omit it to retrieve all types.

Endpoint behavior:
- If `artist` is provided: Filters transfers to moments created by this artist.
- If `collector` is provided: Filters transfers where this address is the collector.
- If `collection` is provided: Filters transfers to moments in this collection.
- If `tokenId` is provided: Filters transfers to a specific token within the collection.
- If `chainId` is provided: Filters transfers to the specified chain.
- If `content_type` is provided: Filters transfers to moments whose content MIME type matches (e.g. `audio`, `video`, `image`).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by transfer type. Omit to retrieve all transfer types. Use `airdrop` for airdrops, `payment` for moment transfers completed via payment.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by artist address (the creator of the collected moments)

parameters.name: collector
parameters.description: Filter by collector address (the address that collected the moments)

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Filter by collection contract address

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Filter by token ID within the specified collection

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (default: Base, 8453)

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Filter by MIME type category (e.g. `audio`, `video`, `image`). Used to construct a MIME pattern filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max: 100, default: 20)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve (default: 1)

get.description:
Retrieve payment records from the In•Process protocol. Supports filtering by artist, collector, and chain. Supports pagination for efficient browsing.

Endpoint behavior:
- If `artist` is provided: Filters payments to moments where this address is one of the artists receiving a share of the payment.
- If `collector` is provided: Filters payments where this address is the buyer.
- If `chainId` is provided: Filters payments to the specified chain.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Transfer type — always `payment` for this endpoint

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filters payments to moments where this address is one of the artists receiving a share of the payment.

parameters.name: collector
parameters.description: Filter by collector address (the address that purchased the token)

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Filter by collection contract address

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Filter by token ID within the specified collection

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (default: Base, 8453)

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Filter by MIME type category (e.g. `audio`, `video`, `image`). Used to construct a MIME pattern filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max: 100, default: 20)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve (default: 1)

post.description:
Distribute funds from a split contract. This endpoint allows you to trigger the distribution of tokens (native or ERC20) from a split contract to its recipients according to their configured allocations.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

get.description:
Retrieve notification records from the In•Process protocol. Supports filtering by artist address and viewed status.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

Endpoint behavior:
- If no parameters are provided: Returns the latest notification records.
- If `artist` is provided: Filters notifications where the artist is the provided address.
- If `viewed` is provided: Filters notifications by their viewed status (true for viewed, false for unviewed).

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by artist address (notifications for this artist)

parameters.name: viewed
parameters.description: Filter by viewed status (true for viewed, false for unviewed)

artist.bio: Digital artist exploring the intersection of technology and creativity

get.description:
Retrieve airdrop records from the In•Process protocol. Supports filtering by artist, collector, and chain. Supports pagination for efficient browsing.

Endpoint behavior:
- If `artist` is provided: Filters airdrops where this address performed the airdrop.
- If `collector` is provided: Filters airdrops where this address received the airdrop.
- If `chainId` is provided: Filters airdrops to the specified chain.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Transfer type — always `airdrop` for this endpoint

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by artist address (the address that performed the airdrop)

parameters.name: collector
parameters.description: Filter by collector address (the address that received the airdrop)

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Filter by collection contract address

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Filter by token ID within the specified collection

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (default: Base, 8453)

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Filter by MIME type category (e.g. `audio`, `video`, `image`). Used to construct a MIME pattern filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max: 100, default: 20)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve (default: 1)

post.description:
Create a new API key for artists on the In•Process protocol.

**Overview:**

Artists can create API keys in two ways:

1. **Programmatically** - Using the API endpoint documented below
2. **Via Web Interface** - Using the [In•Process API Keys Management Site](https://inprocess.world/manage/api-keys)

The web interface provides a user-friendly way to create, view, and manage an artist API keys without writing code.

**Note:** This endpoint requires a Privy access token for authentication. Privy access tokens are obtained through the Privy authentication flow and provide secure access to artist-specific API endpoints. For more information about Privy authentication, see the [Privy documentation](https://docs.privy.io/authentication/user-authentication/access-tokens#getting-the-access-token).

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing Privy access token

get.description: Search for artists by username on the In•Process protocol.

parameters.name: limit

post.description: Connect a wallet to the authenticated artist account on the In•Process protocol using an EIP-191 signed message. The wallet address and client type (`farcaster` or `external`) are derived from the signed message.

400.description: Bad request — invalid message format, invalid signature, wallet already connected, or artist already has a wallet of that type

delete.description: Disconnect a specific wallet from the authenticated artist account.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The `0x`-prefixed EVM address of the wallet to disconnect. Must be one of the authenticated artist's wallets.

400.description: Bad request — invalid address or wallet not found on the authenticated account

get.description: Get all wallets associated with an artist on the In•Process protocol. Returns each wallet's address and type.

parameters.name: artistId
parameters.description: The UUID of the artist whose wallets to retrieve.

400.description: Bad request — invalid or missing `artistId` query parameter

get.description:
Retrieve email addresses for artists on the In•Process protocol.

**Authentication required.**

Endpoint behavior depends on the type of API key used:
- **Normal API key**: No parameters accepted. The artist address is inferred from the API key and returns that artist's own email.
- **Admin API key**: `artist_address` is optional. If provided, returns the email for that specific artist. If omitted, returns a paginated list of all artist emails.

parameters.name: artist_address
parameters.description: The artist wallet address to look up the email for. **Admin API key only.** When provided, returns a single email object for that artist; when omitted, returns all emails paginated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results. Use the `next_cursor` value from the previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of email records to return per page.

oneOf.description: Single artist email response (normal API key, or admin API key with artist_address provided)

email.description: The email address associated with the artist, or null if not found

oneOf.description: Paginated list of artist emails (admin API key only, no artist_address provided)

address.description: The social wallet address associated with the email

artist_address.description: The artist's primary wallet address, or null if not mapped

username.description: The artist's username, or null if not set

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.

403.description: Forbidden - the artist does not have the required API key type for the requested operation

get.description:
Get a smart wallet connected to an artist wallet on the In•Process protocol. This endpoint retrieves the smart wallet address associated with a given artist wallet address.

**This is a public endpoint and does not require authentication.**

parameters.name: artist_wallet
parameters.description: The artist wallet address to get a smart wallet for

post.description: Withdraw funds from a smart wallet. Supports both native ETH and USDC tokens. If amount is not provided, the full balance will be withdrawn. The withdrawal may span multiple smart wallets associated with the artist.

errors.message: Amount must be a valid positive number

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid bearer token

example.message: Failed to withdraw from smart wallet

get.description: Get balances of all social smart wallets associated with an artist address. Returns ETH and USDC balances for each social smart wallet, along with total balances across all wallets.

parameters.name: artist_address
parameters.description: The artist wallet address to get balances for

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID of the network (default: Base, 8453)

post.description:
Connect a phone number for artists on the In•Process protocol. After connection, a verification SMS message will be sent to the provided phone number.

**Overview:**

Artists can connect their phone number to enable SMS-based features and notifications.

1. An SMS verification message is automatically sent to the provided phone number.
   
   For example:
   
   > Someone is trying to connect this phone number to the artist profile for sweetman.eth on In•Process. If this was you, please reply 'yes'. If this was not you, please ignore this message.

2. If the artist replies "yes", the artist's phone number will be verified.
3. With a verified phone number the artist can create new Moments via SMS.

example.message: Phone number connected and verification message sent

400.description: Validation error - Invalid request body or phone number format

500.description: Server error - Failed to connect phone number or send SMS

delete.description:
Disconnect a phone number from an artist's profile on the In•Process protocol. This will remove the phone number association and disable SMS-based features for that number.

**Note:** Disconnecting a phone number will remove it from the artist's profile. After disconnection, SMS-based features will no longer be available for that phone number. The phone number can be re-connected later if needed.

500.description: Server error - Failed to disconnect phone number

get.description:
Proxy and transform images from decentralized storage protocols like Arweave and IPFS. This endpoint fetches images from `ar://`, `ipfs://`, or `https://` URLs and optionally resizes and converts them to a target format.

**Supported URL formats:**
- `ar://` - Arweave URLs (e.g., `ar://abc123...`)
- `ipfs://` - IPFS URLs (e.g., `ipfs://Qm...`)
- `https://` - Direct HTTPS URLs

Images are processed using sharp and can be resized and converted to WebP, AVIF, JPEG, or PNG formats. Responses are cached with immutable cache headers.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the image to fetch. Supports Arweave (`ar://`), IPFS (`ipfs://`), and HTTPS URLs.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Target width in pixels. The image will be resized to fit within this width without enlargement.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Target height in pixels. The image will be resized to fit within this height without enlargement.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Image quality (1-100). Higher values produce better quality but larger files.

parameters.name: f
parameters.description: Output image format.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the output image

Content-Length.description: The size of the image in bytes

get.description:
Stream audio or video content from decentralized storage protocols like Arweave and IPFS. This endpoint acts as a proxy that handles decentralized storage protocols and enables partial content streaming for media players.

**Supported URL formats:**
- `ar://` - Arweave URLs (e.g., `ar://abc123...`)
- `ipfs://` - IPFS URLs (e.g., `ipfs://Qm...`)
- `https://` - Direct HTTPS URLs

The endpoint supports HTTP Range headers for seeking within media files, returning `206 Partial Content` when range requests are supported by the origin.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the media file to stream. Supports Arweave (`ar://`), IPFS (`ipfs://`), and HTTPS URLs.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the media content (e.g., audio/mpeg, video/mp4)

Content-Length.description: The size of the media content in bytes

Accept-Ranges.description: Indicates that the server accepts range requests

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the media content

Content-Length.description: The size of the partial content in bytes

Content-Range.description: The range of bytes being returned

Accept-Ranges.description: Indicates that the server accepts range requests

502.description: Unable to fetch from origin or determine content length

post.description:
Proxy upload requests to the Arweave gateway (`https://arweave.net`). This endpoint forwards the request body as JSON to Arweave, enabling chunked media uploads through the In•Process API.

The upload flow uses two paths:
- `tx` — Post the signed transaction header (with data emptied for chunked upload)
- `chunk` — Post individual data chunks sequentially

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The Arweave path to proxy. Use `tx` for posting transaction headers or `chunk` for uploading data chunks.

requestBody.description: The transaction header or chunk data to upload to Arweave, as JSON.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the response from Arweave

get.description: Proxy requests to fetch and return JSON metadata from a given URI. Supports IPFS and Arweave URIs by resolving them to a fetchable gateway URL before fetching.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: The URI of the metadata to fetch. Supports IPFS (`ipfs://`) and Arweave (`ar://`) URIs.

name.description: Name of the token or asset

description.description: Description of the token or asset

image.description: Arweave or IPFS URI of the asset image

animation_url.description: Arweave or IPFS URI of the animation or media file

content.description: Content metadata for the asset media

mime.description: MIME type of the media content

uri.description: Arweave or IPFS URI of the media content

get.description:
Retrieve the authenticated artist's wallet address and profile.

**Overview:**

This endpoint verifies the Bearer token from the [Login with OTP](/api-reference/oauth/login) endpoint and returns the associated artist address along with their profile information.

1. Include the JWT token obtained from the login flow as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
2. On success, the artist's wallet address and profile are returned.

artistAddress.description: The wallet address of the authenticated artist

username.description: Artist's username. Falls back to ENS name if not set.

phone.description: Artist's connected phone number (omitted if not set)

500.description: Server error - Failed to retrieve user info

post.description:
Authenticate an account using an email address and a one-time verification code (OTP).

**Overview:**

This endpoint completes the email login flow. After receiving a verification code via the [Send Code](/api-reference/oauth/send-code) endpoint:

1. Provide the same email address and the 6-digit code from the email.
2. The code is verified against Privy's passwordless authentication.
3. On success, a JWT auth token and the associated Privy embedded wallet address (`social_wallet`) are returned. The token expires in 1 hour and should be included as a Bearer token in subsequent authenticated requests.

400.description: Validation error - Invalid email or code format

post.description:
Send a one-time verification code to the provided email address for email-based OAuth login.

**Overview:**

This endpoint initiates the email login flow by sending a one-time PIN (OTP) to the account’s email address via Privy.

1. Provide a valid email address in the request body.
2. A one-time verification code will be sent to that email.
3. Use the received code with the [Login with OTP](/api-reference/oauth/login) endpoint to complete the authentication flow.

500.description: Server error - Failed to send verification code

get.description: Paginated Arweave upload usage and costs. Optional `period` limits how far back results go (`day`, `week`, `month`, or omit / `all`). Optional `artist` filters by wallet (`0x` + 40 hex) or username. Results are ordered by `sort_by` (`usdc_cost` or `winc_cost`) and `sort_order` (`asc` or `desc`); default is `usdc_cost` descending.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Restrict results to approximately the last day, week, or month. Omit or use `all` for no time limit.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (1 to 100). Default 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Filter by wallet (`0x` + 40 hex) or username.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by total USDC or total WinC.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`.

200.description: Successful response; see schema for field meanings.

uploads.description: One object per artist: that artist's total WinC, total USDC (string with six decimal places), and `artist` (username and address).

usdc_cost.description: Total USDC for that artist, six decimal places.

count.description: Total number of artists matching the request (for pagination).

total_usdc_cost.description: Sum of USDC across all matching artists (not only the current page).

errors.message: Number must be greater than or equal to 1

post.description: Fetch a file from the given URL and upload it to Arweave permanent storage. Small files under 5 MB are free once per month per artist; larger or additional uploads debit USDC from the artist's smart wallet.

402.description: Insufficient USDC balance in smart wallet

post.description:
Get the onchain moment creation proposal action for a Nouns governance proposal.
